description: Ask any working parent, and they will tell you: child care is one of the biggest challenges they face. Finding quality care is hard. Affording it is even harder. And for many families, the math simply does not work. The cost of child care can rival a mortgage payment, forcing parents to make impossible choices.This is not just a family issue.
